title: A Note on Sphere Packing Bounds for Tuple Lattice Sieving
summary: A finite set of unit vectors is $k$-irreducible if every signed sum of between two and $k$ distinct elements has norm greater than one. Let $\mathcal{R}_k$ be the maximal asymptotic rate of such sets, and let $κ(α)$ be the maximal asymptotic rate of spherical codes with pairwise inner products at most $α$. For $k \ge 2$ we show: \begin{align} \mathcal{R}_k \le \min_{1 \le r \le \lfloor k/2 \rfloor} \frac{1}{r} \, κ\!\left(1 - \frac{1}{2r}\right) \, . \end{align} Combining this with standard sphere packing bounds, for large $k$ we obtain an almost-tight asymptotic comparison with the known…
